# Third-Party Dependencies & Licenses

All computational dependencies are open-source (no commercial solver licenses required):
- **NumPy** (BSD-3-Clause): `licenses/NumPy_LICENSE.txt`
- **SciPy** (BSD-3-Clause): `licenses/SciPy_LICENSE.txt`
- **Matplotlib** (PSF-based): `licenses/Matplotlib_LICENSE.txt`
- **CVXPY** (Apache-2.0): `licenses/CVXPY_LICENSE.txt`
- **Clarabel** (Apache-2.0): Open-source interior-point conic solver (<https://github.com/oxfordcontrol/Clarabel.rs>)
- **USDOT / FHWA NGSIM I-80 Excerpt** (CC BY-SA 3.0 / 4.0, DOI `10.21949/1504477`): See `data/raw/external/README.md`.
